legend.0: No evaluation of the contribution is reported.
legend.1: An evaluation in one setting, with no baseline or alternative compared.
legend.2: A comparison to at least one baseline or alternative is reported.
legend.3: Baselines and an ablation isolating a component or design choice are reported.
legend.4: Baselines and ablations are reported, with variation over seeds or runs, intervals or a statistical test.

legend.0: No limitation or caveat is stated.
legend.2: A concrete assumption, failure case or scope restriction relevant to the contribution is stated.
legend.3: Concrete limitations are stated and failure cases are shown.

legend.0: An incremental improvement or extension of existing work.
legend.1: A new method for an existing problem.
legend.2: A new problem, task or capability.
legend.3: A new paradigm for its field.
